sanskrit_devanagari: यथा चतुर्भिः कनकं परीक्ष्यते निघर्षणच्छेदनतापताडनैः । तथा चतुर्भिः पुरुषः परीक्ष्यते त्यागेन शीलेन गुणेन कर्मणा ॥
iast_transliteration: yathā caturbhiḥ kanakaṃ parīkṣyate nigharṣaṇacchedanatāpatāḍanaiḥ | tathā caturbhiḥ puruṣaḥ parīkṣyate tyāgena śīlena guṇena karmaṇā ||
english_translation: As gold is tested in four ways, by rubbing, cutting, heating and hammering, so a person is tested in four ways: by generosity, conduct, qualities and deeds.
modern_application: When a volunteer requests custody of a shared instrument, compare references with observed handling before handing it over.
application_limit: A personality label cannot establish misconduct.

relationship: editorial thematic parallel; cover alone does not establish verse attribution
english_translation: Mastery of the senses, a basis of discipline in learning, is to be brought about by abandoning desire, anger, greed, conceit, intoxication with pride and rash delight.
modern_application: A procurement lead wants to reward an agreeable supplier. Score all offers against the criteria recorded before the meeting.
application_limit: A personal preference warrants a check. It does not establish corruption.

sanskrit_devanagari: मनसा चिन्तितं कार्यं वाचा नैव प्रकाशयेत् । मन्त्रेण रक्षयेद्गूढं कार्ये चापि नियोजयेत् ॥
iast_transliteration: manasā cintitaṃ kāryaṃ vācā naiva prakāśayet | mantreṇa rakṣayedgūḍhaṃ kārye cāpi niyojayet ||
english_translation: Do not announce in speech the work conceived in the mind. Guard it in confidence through counsel and put it into effect.
modern_application: Before revealing a negotiating ceiling, ask who needs it to approve the offer and when disclosure becomes necessary.
application_limit: Confidentiality cannot excuse a misleading assurance.

relationship: editorial thematic parallel; cover alone does not establish verse attribution
sanskrit_devanagari: उपार्जितानां वित्तानां त्याग एव हि रक्षणम् । तडागोदरसंस्थानां परीवाह इवाम्भसाम् ॥
iast_transliteration: upārjitānāṃ vittānāṃ tyāga eva hi rakṣaṇam | taḍāgodarasaṃsthānāṃ parīvāha ivāmbhasām ||
english_translation: Giving away acquired wealth is precisely its preservation, like an outlet for water held in a reservoir.
modern_application: Review committed outgoings before releasing an idle cooperative surplus for a member project.
application_limit: The reservoir metaphor supplies no investment return or spending rule.

english_translation: When the three agree in their account, confidence is warranted.
modern_application: Three coworkers repeat an allegation. Trace whether each witnessed the event before treating the reports as corroboration.
application_limit: Repetition of one story is one evidentiary channel.

relationship: editorial thematic parallel; cover alone does not establish verse attribution
sanskrit_devanagari: जानीयात्प्रेषणे भृत्यान्बान्धवान् व्यसनागमे । मित्रं चापत्तिकालेषु भार्यां च विभवक्षये ॥
iast_transliteration: jānīyātpreṣaṇe bhṛtyānbāndhavān vyasanāgame | mitraṃ cāpattikāleṣu bhāryāṃ ca vibhavakṣaye ||
english_translation: One should know servants by sending them on a task, relatives when adversity arrives, a friend in times of distress and a wife when wealth has declined.
modern_application: When choosing a backup coordinator, ask what support each person actually provided during a previous disruption and what constraints they faced.
application_limit: Manufacturing a crisis to test loyalty would corrupt the evidence.

relationship: editorial thematic parallel; cover alone does not establish verse attribution
sanskrit_devanagari: परोक्षे कार्यहन्तारं प्रत्यक्षे प्रियवादिनम् । वर्जयेत्तादृशं मित्रं विषकुम्भं पयोमुखम् ॥
iast_transliteration: parokṣe kāryahantāraṃ pratyakṣe priyavādinam | varjayettādṛśaṃ mitraṃ viṣakumbhaṃ payomukham ||
english_translation: Avoid a friend who frustrates your work behind your back and speaks pleasantly to your face, like a jar of poison with milk at its mouth.
modern_application: A collaborator praises a proposal but is accused of blocking its agreed handoff. Verify the handoff record, hear their explanation and limit reliance if deliberate obstruction is established.
application_limit: A smile, disagreement or missed handoff alone gives no basis for distrust.

relationship: editorial thematic parallel; cover alone does not establish verse attribution
sanskrit_devanagari: श्लोकेन वा तदर्धेन तदर्धार्धाक्षरेण वा । अबन्ध्यं दिवसं कुर्याद्दानाध्ययनकर्मभिः ॥
iast_transliteration: ślokena vā tadardhena tadardhārdhākṣareṇa vā | abandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryāddānādhyayanakarmabhiḥ ||
english_translation: With a verse, half of it, or even the syllables of a quarter verse, make the day fruitful through giving, study and work.
modern_application: An apprentice has little time between shifts. Choose one short passage, explain it from memory and apply it to one question.
application_limit: The verse also commends giving and work. It establishes no daily productivity quota.

observed_theme: Bereavement and dependence in later life
relationship: close paraphrase across all three elements
sanskrit_devanagari: वृद्धकाले मृता भार्या बन्धुहस्तगतं धनम् । भोजनं च पराधीनं तिस्रः पुंसां विडम्बनाः ॥
iast_transliteration: vṛddhakāle mṛtā bhāryā bandhuhastagataṃ dhanam | bhojanaṃ ca parādhīnaṃ tisraḥ puṃsāṃ viḍambanāḥ ||
english_translation: Losing one’s wife in old age, having one’s wealth in relatives’ hands, and depending on others for food are three painful predicaments for a man.
modern_application: When one household member handles food deliveries and all payment access, ask each person what backup access and support they want if that member becomes unavailable.
application_limit: The verse describes vulnerability in a male householder’s terms. Bereavement is not a planning failure, and receiving help does not diminish dignity.
